critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — should migrate to FastAPI lifespan handler (non-blocking, minor).

/api/insights swallows LLM streaming exceptions into the text body ('[Error generating insights: ...]') with HTTP 200; consider distinguishing transport vs content errors so frontend can show a proper error UI.

Optimizer initial defaults already equal the spreadsheet target values (350k/150k); a fresh user edit to the same value yields no recompute — acceptable UX but worth surfacing a 'recalculated' indicator on the optimizer card for parity with projection's 'updating…' label.
seed_data_creation: Created/deleted TEST_scn_* and TEST_ui_* scenarios via API and UI; all cleaned up.
